{{Top|leg}}
In the sport of [[phrenbi]], each pair of teams were called '''osk'y''', translated as "enemies" or "rivals." These two teams were opponents and could only score against each other. They could not score against the other osk'y in the game. There were two winners in the game, one from each pair of osk'y.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
